correctness.rationale: The projective design identity AA^T=(k-lambda)I+lambda J leads to the three explicit nonconstant powered-distance eigenvalue branches with exact multiplicities. A uniform root comparison proves q>=3 never loses the contrast mode first; in binary projective spaces, rational power inequalities establish the exact d=4 to d=5 switch and rule out later reversals. Strictness, endpoint ranks, Gaussian-kernel universality and both asymptotics follow analytically. A freshly extracted standalone checker verifies incidence matrices and full graph distances and tests the eigenvector identities in eight representative geometries.

value.rationale: The precise sharp Gaussian-kernel exponent and its critical eigenspace on a canonical infinite family of projective homogeneous spaces show a genuine characteristic-two dimension boundary at d=5. Endpoint embedding dimension jumps between v and 2v-2 and asymptotic decay switches from q^{-(d-1)/2} to 2^{-d}. These are motivated natural metric-kernel invariants, not a finite table or immediate ordinary-spectrum corollary.
